overview: The Medford License Commission met to consider multiple one-day liquor licenses, business amendments, and routine updates. The commission approved one-day license applications and conditional venue adjustments, tabled a manager change for Smashburger, and discussed upcoming annual license renewals.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the September 21, 2022 meeting minutes with an added note regarding ongoing research into municipal barstool restrictions.

items.title: Status Update: 21 Main Street Restaurant Group
items.summary: Maury Carroll reported that 21 Main Street Restaurant Group will not renew its liquor license at its current location as leadership reorganizes into a new operating group.

items.title: One-Day License: Friends of the Medford Public Library
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day beer and wine license for the Friends of the Medford Public Library annual meeting on November 5, 2022.

items.title: One-Day License: Tufts University Fletcher School Event
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day license for Tufts University's Fletcher Graduate School Asia Night on October 22, 2022, at Breed Hall, pending receipt of updated insurance.

items.title: One-Day License: Neighborhood Produce LLC
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day license for Neighborhood Produce LLC to host a fifth-anniversary event in its parking lot on November 5, 2022.

items.title: One-Day License: City Event at Wright's Pond
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day wine and malt license for a City of Medford fall event at Wright's Pond on October 29, 2022.

items.title: License Amendment: Ocean State Job Lot
items.summary: The commission approved an officer amendment appointing Bob McGrath as the new LLC manager for Ocean State Job Lot, subject to clarifying a principal's address.

items.title: Change of Manager: Smashburger
items.summary: The commission tabled Smashburger's application to change its manager to Ruben Silvestri until the applicant can attend a future meeting.

items.title: Permit Amendment: Medford Farmers Market
items.summary: The commission conditionally approved changing the time and location of the Medford Farmers Market's November 20, 2022 event to City Hall, pending submission of a layout diagram.

items.title: General Business and Renewal Deadlines
items.summary: Commissioners discussed upcoming November liquor license renewal requirements and reviewed available all-alcohol license counts in the city.
